name: The Observatory
patron: The yard, out of the commons line on every manifest.
holds: Two people and an instrument, watching the ten-mile traverse.
because: Somebody has to keep looking at a thing that has not changed in a hundred years, on the chance that it does. Nobody will fund this against a deliverable, because the honest deliverable is a century of nothing with one entry in it.
study: What the cloud deck does over a span longer than any single career. Every measurement is worth more in fifty years than it is today, which is exactly the property that makes it unfundable by anybody expecting a return.
anchor: Tycho Brahe held Hven from Frederick II for twenty years and produced no product at all — only the most accurate positional data anybody had, which Kepler then used to find the ellipse. The patron was dead before the return arrived and the return was not his.
